call.summary: Hold at the verified $84.99 close. The base scenario values a share at $95.50, only 12.4% upside, while modeled existing-holder dilution reaches 34.7%.
call.driver: The base requires $11.36B of net new equity through November 27, 2027, even with customer advances and project loans. That means 151.56M financing shares, plus a separate 15.23M reserve for share awards.
call.strongest_objection: Management expects advances and asset-backed financing to cover 75–85% of 2027 capex. If spending is 20% lower while revenue and financing remain unchanged, modeled value rises to $132.32; preserving revenue with less spending is the optimistic assumption.
call.falsifier: Upgrade only when a refreshed model offers at least 25% upside and no more than 25% dilution, supported by documented funding for at least 75% of planned capex and remaining New Jersey delivery by Q2 2027. Downgrade if funding coverage falls below 75% without replacement, or further delivery delays impair customer economics.

original_model.method: Justin independent assumptions, not consensus or management guidance. Revenue=average revenue-earning MW×realized annual $M/MW+other. D&A=average in-service GPU cost/5+infrastructure D&A. Gross profit=revenue×(1−cash cost ratio)−all D&A (analytical fully burdened definition). EBITDA=revenue×(1−cash cost ratio)−cash opex−SBC; includes SBC, unlike issuer adjusted EBITDA shown in inputs. Pretax=EBITDA−D&A−average debt×cash interest rate−noncash customer-financing interest+average cash×cash yield. Net income=pretax−max(pretax,0)×20%; no tax benefit on losses or investment marks. FCF=net income+D&A+SBC+noncash customer-financing interest+new prepayments−recognition of prepaid revenue−other WC−capex. No debt proceeds in FCF. All debt interest expensed for conservative comparability; no capitalized-interest benefit.
gaps: Average earning MW is a scenario driver, not disclosed live installed MW; utilization and commissioning embedded once.
New-contract >$25M ACV/MW is not fleet realized yield; selected lower/higher yields model mix and repricing.
Cohort commissioning, useful-life mix and cash prepayment recognition schedule are not disclosed in enough detail for precise GAAP forecasts.
No proceeds from strategic investment disposals; no speculative gains. All D&A assigned to gross profit analytically, unlike issuer presentation.

multiple_rationale.classification: Analyst valuation assumption, not an independently observed peer multiple
multiple_rationale.rationale: A 6× sales valuation capitalizes sustained growth beyond FY2027, not merely one year of customer advances. At the modeled 60.3% EBITDA margin, it implies about 10× EBITDA; at a mature 40% margin it is 15×, and at 30% it is 20×. The base therefore already requires strong economics and continued growth. It is an explicit risk hurdle, not evidence that NBIS is cheap versus observed peers.
multiple_rationale.cash_note: These are illustrative mature unlevered cash margins before financing, new growth capex and working capital, with maintenance capex and tax both assumed. They are not near-term free cash flow or a DCF. At 6× sales the implied cash yields are only 0.5%, 1.7% and 4.7%, so continued growth matters.
multiple_rationale.valuation_ranges: Bear 3× sales reflects failed growth economics/funding; base 6× requires stronger execution; bull 9× prices durable premium growth. None is an independent trading-comparable observation.

nonoperating_investments.basis: Conservative exclusion from both scenario equity value and cash funding; not an assertion that stakes are worthless. conversion_audit.trigger_context: A $267.72 bull target exceeds the June and September 2025 ordinary price-trigger ceilings even at maximum accretion (about $83.61 and $207.43). Eligibility also requires a sustained trading path and other contractual conditions. March 2026 ordinary trigger thresholds run from about $234–238 before accretion to about $281–286 at maximum accretion; the exact October 2027 stage and holder election are not reconstructed. August 2026 ordinary thresholds exceed about $407 before accretion and are not assumed met.
